summary: Iter19 (Crafters Plus subscription + off-site ad attribution + per-maker commission) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS (test_iter19_plus_offsite + test_revenue). All 4 backend curl probes (subscription GET / start / profile PATCH / fee_breakdown helper) PASS. Frontend Maker Dashboard Billing tab → Plus card + perks + Stripe Checkout redirect PASS. Off-site attribution localStorage→cart→checkout pipe PASS — attribution_source='instagram' correctly forwarded in POST /api/checkout/session body. Iron-and-oak left clean (subscription_status='free', external_ads_opt_out=false).
action_items: Minor doc nit: review request said the Plus perks list has 4 bullets; the actual subscription endpoint and rendered Billing card show 5 perks (15 free listings/month, 4.0% commission vs 5%, Advanced shop analytics, Custom shop banner image, Off-site ad surcharge waived when opted in). The 5-perk version is correct/intentional per /api/maker/subscription response — handoff text just needs updating.

Minor: GET /api/maker/billing 'policy' block shows ENV defaults (platform_fee_bps=500) regardless of subscription_status. This is by design (platform-wide policy), but if the BillingTab UI ever wants to show 'your effective rate', it should compute via fee_breakdown_cents (which DOES respect subscription_status). Not a bug, just noting for future UX polish.
critical_code_review_comments: fee_breakdown_cents correctly applies plus 4% vs free 5% commission, plus 12% off-site surcharge gated by maker.external_ads_opt_out flag — all 4 paths (free/plus × no-attr/attr) covered by unit tests and verified live against Mongo-flipped maker.

subscriptions.py start endpoint returns a real Stripe Checkout URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...) for subscription mode — wiring is correct. Not testing webhook here per directive (would need Stripe CLI replay).

CartPage.checkout() correctly calls getAttributionSource() from /lib/analytics and forwards it as attribution_source in createCheckout payload. Verified via page.expect_request capture of POST /api/checkout/session body.
PATCH /api/maker/profile {external_ads_opt_out:true} round-trips and returns the flag. (Cleanup reset flag back to false.)
revenue.accrue_listing_charge: Plus subscriber's 1st of month is free; 16th charges $0.20 — both verified by motor-mock unit tests.
test_credentials: Maker JWT issued via maker_auth.issue_magic_token('iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org') → POST /api/maker/auth/verify (expires in ~7 days from issue). No new credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seeds. Temporarily flipped iron-and-oak subscription_status='active' in Mongo to verify per-maker fee_breakdown_cents (commission_cents=400 confirmed), then reset to 'free'. Temporarily flipped external_ads_opt_out=true via PATCH then reset to false. Final state: iron-and-oak subscription_status='free', external_ads_opt_out=false (verified post-test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart localStorage key is 'cm_cart_v1' (not 'cm_cart' — easy gotcha when seeding cart for E2E tests). Attribution localStorage keys: cm_attribution_source + cm_attribution_ts (ms epoch). Checkout request body field is 'attribution_source' (snake_case). Plus subscription Stripe Checkout URL is created on first /api/maker/subscription/start call (caches Product+Price in db.platform_meta) — subsequent calls reuse the cached price. Webhook flow (customer.subscription.*) NOT tested live; would need Stripe CLI replay. The known flaky test_iter8 TestTransferGroupPairing test and test_iter11_web_analytics.py file remain pre-existing skip-cases.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
